# Novo Reperio Sdn Bhd

Novo Reperio is a spatial capture and immersive visualization company based in
Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Founded in 2014, we have delivered 400+ projects for
hotels, developers, venues, showrooms, corporates and cultural institutions
across Malaysia, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and worldwide.

Novo Reperio is a Matterport Certified Service Partner since 2015.

## What we do
- Matterport digital twins (Pro3 LiDAR capture, hosted twins, embed-ready)
- 360° virtual tours (ground level and aerial)
- Drone capture and 4K aerial video
- Scan to BIM (LiDAR point clouds converted to as-built BIM models)
- Photoreal CGI stills (interiors, exteriors, aerials, dusk hero shots)
- Virtual show units and 3D 360° rendered tours for pre-sale developments
- Property walkthrough films and cinematic launch videos
- Unreal Engine 5 (UE5) masterplan and web-streamed experiences
- AI-assisted visualization, finished by human artists
- Launch-ready microsites that package tours, films and CGI for distribution

## Sectors we serve
Hospitality (hotels, resorts, F&B), event and convention venues, property
developers (residential, commercial, mixed-use), corporate workplaces, retail
and showrooms, cultural institutions and museums, oil & gas / industrial
safety training, aviation and yachts.

## Indicative pricing (MYR)
- Airbnb / Homestay → Matterport capture from RM988
- Residential or Show Unit → from RM2,599
- Commercial / Showroom → from RM2,599
- Small Event Space / F&B → from RM5,999
- Hotel / Resort, Office / Corporate Facility, Large Venue / Convention / Industrial → custom scope, sized by area and complexity, quoted after a scoping walkthrough
- Hosting & virtual-tour subscription → from RM499/month

Final quotes scoped per property; terms & conditions apply.
